Definition: middle voice from G2596 and G4679; to be crafty against, i.e. circumvent:--deal subtilly with.
BiblicalUsage: Pharaoh dealt subtly with our kindred, and evil entreated our fathers, so that they cast out their young children to the end they might not live.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the subtlety of Pharaoh is the devil's craft, and God saw it and answered it with deliverance.
RelatedEvents: The Exodus and the Red Sea
